description: Use when you want one stock's risk split into market, sector, subsector and residual layers, or the ETF hedge legs for a dollar position in it. Not for several stocks (use riskmodels_compare) or a portfolio (use riskmodels_analyze_portfolio). Returns, from POST /decompose, each layer's explained-risk share, hedge ratio and hedge ETF, chart-ready data and a one-line summary; with dollars it returns the ETF hedge notionals for that position at each level (hedge ratio times dollars). End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.005 per call.

dollars.description: Position size in US dollars, a positive number, e.g. 10000. Omit for the decomposition alone

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, case-insensitive, e.g. NVDA

name: riskmodels_decompose
title: RiskModels Single-Stock Decomposition
